notes.title: 2025 Publisher Sale
notes.content:
Today kicks off the big 2 Left Thumbs Publisher Sale!
Explore the full event page to scope out loads of discounts, free games, bundles and more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39217323/c11f237f089d5f895f0e8ba5921ebf80e931d8ee.png

How about a FREE game?!
Croak Crusader: Spawn of the Spore Spectre launched TODAY, and is available 100% for free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2997920/Croak_Crusader_Spawn_of_the_Spore_Spectre/

This free title introduces the general gameplay, protagonist and antagonists of the upcoming (paid) release, Croak Crusader: the Champion of Canada. Be sure to add that to your Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3152060/Croak_Crusader_the_Champion_of_Canada/

COMING SOON
Very VERY soon! Novus Orbis is a combo-based roguelike deckbuilder, set to release into Early Access on February 10th. There's already dozens of hours of content, and the game will only be getting deeper and more varied from here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2437330/Novus_Orbis/

NEW UPDATES
A collection of games have all timed free updates and big announcements for this event!

WizardChess
WizardChess is a chess-like tactical roguelike with a near infinitely replayable amount of variety and depth. And today takes us a step closer to FULLY infinite replayability, with the addition of Daily Runs!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274210/WizardChess/

Starground
At the end of 2024 Starground revealed a planned development roadmap. Today sees the Brewconomic Cropdate, adding animals, fishing, potion brewing, and an improved Space Hub.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2793380/Starground/

Magenta Horizon
In addition to making the awesome art for this sale, solo-dev Maddison Baek has crafted new community items for Magenta Horizon! Play the game to earn Trading Cards, and unlock awesome profile backgrounds and other Steam goodies.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2109060/Magenta_Horizon__Neverending_Harvest/

Schism
Schism has a new update dropping Feb 10th that adds some end-game content, and enhanced controller support. Keep your eyes peeled for that! But the BIG news here, is that Schism is leaving Early Access MARCH 10th!! There is no discount now, so as not to conflict with that launch discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2084300/Schism/

Tower of Kalemonvo
While this classic-style hack n slash ARPG isn't out yet, it did just receive yet another demo update. The name of the game right now is polish, preparing for our newly set released date of MARCH 28th!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2351860/Tower_of_Kalemonvo/

FOLLOW ALONG
Follow 2 Left Thumbs on social media to stay up-to-date on all the latest games and news. 👇

 Bluesky

 Instagram
 YouTube
 Discord
 Twitter
LOGO UPDATE
I'm burying the lead a little here. But as a part of this event, I'm also debuting a redesigned 2 Left Thumbs Publishing logo - made by Fiend Folio artist RedRachis!

notes.title: Announcing THEY SPEAK: ZENITH
notes.content:
THEY SPEAK: ZENITH is coming soon.

Early on after the THEY SPEAK Kickstarter, it was clear that the original engine was inadequate to match Nikki's ambitions for the project. This led to restarting development in a new RPG framework. This added freedom and flexibility opened many doors, but some practice was still needed. Thus, ZENITH was born!

It will be completely Free, and arrives June 26th!

[previewyoutube=9QsIFZymjck;full][/previewyoutube]
What started as a tech demo, slowly and naturally blossomed into a standalone Prologue for THEY SPEAK. Be sure to add it to your Wishlists so you don't miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393290/They_Speak_From_The_Abyss_Zenith/

notes.title: NEW and Expanded Demo
notes.content:
First off, THEY SPEAK FROM THE ABYSS was recently picked up for a feature in Japan's 4Gamer. How cool is that?! This comes after the announcement of a brand new Demo (Available to play on the store NOW!)

For the last 3 months, 2 of those after a successful Kickstarter - switching to full-steam ahead - a revised demo has been in the works for THEY SPEAK. This game gained a fair amount of attention early in it's development, and has scaled up quickly since. This new demo feels much more representative of the scope and style you should expect in the full game!

Explore two new areas: 🌹 The Forest of Agape and the 🌆City of Dis
🗡️ See the beginnings of the combat system
👿 Avoid the demons of the labyrinthine Abyss
✨ Heaps of polish applied to the base demo.
⁉️ And more!

THEY SPEAK Presskit

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42687705/7e7722baf1cf7e10f0995ec41818cc48944e67cd.jpg
Check out the brand new logo, crafted by iamdemidevi

Several voice actors have been hired to further add the immersion. We hope that with this new demo, the exploration feels deeper, the atmosphere feels nastier than ever, and that you come away wanting MORE!

The new demo should take about 30-60 minutes to play, depending how much you stop and smell those twisted, otherworldly roses...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42687705/ca734a8d3afab08619f92f8ca74b07a6ab001dbf.jpg

NOTE: While this expanded demo will remain on itch, it will only have a limited window on Steam. We'll be quietly taking it down on February 6th. We'd love and appreciate your feedback for this snapshot of development! But the game is changing so quickly, and it would take valuable time away from development to continually update new builds.

notes.title: Kickstarter 121% FUNDED (Only 24 Hours Left)
notes.content:
WE'RE FUNDED
The Kickstarter has been a great success!
We are currently sitting at 121%. That's already WONDERFUL!
The full game WILL be made (with additional content already planned)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42687705/7037d9b04e3a4caff85ca0bd259ff3a7e62bb53c.png

But it doesn't stop here.
In these final 24 hours, we'll see if we can cross off any additional Stretch Goals!

STRETCH GOALS
These milestones of funding will allow THEY SPEAK to release with additional content for all buyers. It's a massive win-win-win in any Kickstarter Campaign!

☑ $23,000 (115%) Melancholy Manor - Brave the burning shores of the boiling river of blood in the new River Phlegethon and Melancholy Manor dungeon, a fully realized version of the dungeon found in the prototype of the game!

-------------

$25,000 (125%) Fishing Minigame - Catch wretched fish and trade them into the damned mariner giant in Lake Cocytus to gain additional stat perks, items, and skills.

$26,000 (130%) Pastures of Paradise -  Ascend to Paradise in this optional end game procedurally generated dungeon crawling with horrific angelic abominations and learn more about the tragic history of the realm of eternal torment.

$30,000 (150%) They Speak SIDESTORY: Cycle of Sin - A short prologue chapter following another soul who fell into the Abyss. This will tie directly into the larger story to teach you more about previously seen, but poorly understood elements of the game.

$34,000 (170%) Demon Romance Mechanics - Gain 'Agape' with your demonic companions to unlock secret sub stories and unleash new powers. You also get to kiss the demon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42687705/4477fd7a859098bc18ca789c3c6f0ab3d34a1361.png

THANK YOU!!
Please do consider supporting the campaign if you can. Not only will you get the game for cheap and supporting it's development, but that additional funding helps push us collectively closer to our next Stretch Goals! 

Regardless of any financial backing, thank you all for your support! It was a weird journey trying to promote a game primarily through a social media platform that seemed to be collapsing day-by-day. We are eternally grateful :)

notes.title: Kickstarter live NOW + New demo
notes.content:
Kickstarter live NOW
Our crowdfunding campaign went live this morning. It's only been 2 hours, and the Kickstarter is already 27% funded!! With your help, we know we can make this game into something *incredibly* special!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42687705/971358dc1ac6ba696822c94d4624d2f7e038e2d1.png
Don't miss your chance to back this passion project, and earn some cool rewards along the way!

NEW DEMO
A sparkly (well... more grimy and slimy than sparkly) new demo is in the works. We wanted desperately for it to be ready for both the Kickstarter and Steam Scream Fest - but polishing up the combat is taking some extra effort. We wouldn't want to set a precedent of sacrificing quality just to push something out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42687705/94abf9758ae99771f294a3cd23a505958104dcce.png

Here is an early peek at how the combat system will look. We'll update it as SOON as it's ready to go public. Keep an eye out on Nikki's twitter for updates on the game, Kickstarter, and demo!
